subject: DI01000191

intro_text.en: Bilingual teaching notes with construction, working, applications and revision. Exam has questions only. Use supervised models; no actual practical is claimed.
intro_text.gu: English technical keywords સાથે સરળ ગુજરાતી સમજ. Construction, working, applications અને revision. Exam માં માત્ર પ્રશ્નો. Supervised model વાપરો; actual practical નો દાવો નથી.

body.en:
An air compressor uses mechanical work to raise air pressure for storage or supply. Compression usually raises temperature; cooling and moisture control can be needed in a practical system. The motor supplies energy; compressed air stores usable energy with significant losses and hazards.

Applications include pneumatic tools, controls, process air and suitable workshop systems. Compressed air is not automatically safe breathing air or a harmless cleaning jet.
body.gu:
Air compressor mechanical work વડે air pressure વધારે. Compression થી T સામાન્ય રીતે વધે; practical system માં cooling/moisture control જોઈએ. Motor energy આપે; compressed air માં stored energy/hazards છે.

Pneumatic tools, controls/process air માટે. આ આપોઆપ breathing air અથવા harmless cleaning jet નથી.

body.en:
Positive-displacement types include reciprocating piston and rotary screw/vane designs. Dynamic types include centrifugal and axial compressors. Classify separately by single/multi-stage, single/double-acting, lubrication and application.

A single-stage machine compresses from inlet to delivery pressure in one compression stage; multi-stage uses successive stages, often with intercooling. Number of cylinders alone does not uniquely define number of stages.
body.gu:
Positive-displacement માં reciprocating piston અને rotary screw/vane; dynamic માં centrifugal/axial. Single/multi-stage, single/double-acting, lubrication અને application અલગ axes છે.

Single-stage માં inlet થી delivery એક stage માં; multi-stage successive stages, ઘણીવાર intercooling સાથે. Cylinder count એકલો stage count નથી.

body.en:
Cylinder/head, piston/rings, rod/crankshaft, bearings/crankcase, inlet filter, suction/discharge valves, drive and cooling arrangements form the basic compressor. A system may also include receiver, gauge, pressure switch/unloader, relief protection and moisture-management equipment.

The receiver stores air and buffers demand; it is not the piston cylinder. A pressure switch controls normal running within design limits; the certified relief device is separate protection.
body.gu:
Cylinder/head, piston/rings, rod/crank, bearings/crankcase, inlet filter, suction/discharge valves, drive/cooling મુખ્ય parts. System માં receiver, gauge, pressure switch/unloader, relief અને moisture equipment હોઈ શકે.

Receiver storage/buffering કરે; piston cylinder નથી. Pressure switch normal control છે; relief device separate protection છે.

body.en:
Piston movement increases cylinder volume. Residual clearance gas first expands; when cylinder pressure falls below inlet pressure enough to open the suction valve, fresh air enters. Discharge valve remains closed.

This explains why intake does not necessarily begin immediately at the instant piston motion reverses. Actual valve timing depends on pressure differences and dynamics.
body.gu:
Piston થી volume વધે. Clearance gas પહેલાં expand થાય; cylinder p inlet કરતાં યોગ્ય ઓછું થાય ત્યારે suction valve ખૂલે અને fresh air આવે. Discharge બંધ.

Motion reverse થાય તે જ ક્ષણે intake શરૂ થાય એવું જરૂરી નથી; pressure difference અને valve dynamics મહત્વનાં છે.

body.en:
On the return movement, the suction valve closes and trapped air is compressed. When cylinder pressure exceeds the delivery-side requirement enough, discharge valve opens and compressed air leaves. Compression/discharge are phases within the movement, not necessarily separate full piston strokes.

After delivery, a small volume remains at the end of travel. This clearance avoids mechanical contact and accommodates valves, but residual gas reduces fresh intake through re-expansion.
body.gu:
Return movement માં suction બંધ અને trapped air compress થાય. Cylinder p delivery requirement કરતાં પૂરતું વધે ત્યારે discharge valve ખૂલે. Compression/delivery movement ના phases છે, હંમેશાં જુદા full strokes નહીં.

End પર clearance volume રહે; contact ટાળે/valves માટે જગ્યા આપે. Residual gas re-expand થતાં fresh intake ઘટે.

body.en:
Clearance volume is the remaining cylinder space at the closest piston position; it is not a deliberate leak. Its gas re-expands before suction and affects volumetric performance. Single-stage means one pressure-rise stage, not zero clearance or a single event.

Compression work increases air energy and temperature under ordinary conditions. Lubrication, cooling and compatible materials matter; the elementary cycle picture does not specify service pressure or oil grade.
body.gu:
Clearance volume piston closest position પર બાકી જગ્યા છે; intentional leak નહીં. તેની gas re-expand થાય અને intake/performance પર અસર કરે. Single-stage એટલે એક pressure-rise stage.

Compression work થી air energy/T વધે. Cooling/lubrication/material જરૂરી; basic picture operating pressure અથવા oil grade આપતું નથી.

body.en:
Match delivery pressure, usable flow, duty cycle, air quality, noise and energy consumption to the load. Free-air delivery and volume measured at discharge conditions are not interchangeable without pressure/temperature references.

Pneumatic tools need compatible regulation/filtering/lubrication where specified; instrument/food/medical duties may need stricter air quality. “Oil-free” does not by itself certify air for breathing or sterile service.
body.gu:
Delivery p, usable flow, duty cycle, air quality, noise અને energy load પ્રમાણે match કરો. Free-air delivery અને discharge-condition volume reference વગર સમાન નથી.

Tools માટે specified regulation/filter/lubrication; medical/food/instrument માટે stricter quality. Oil-free એટલે breathing/sterile certified આપોઆપ નહીં.

body.en:
Pressure vessels and hoses can release dangerous stored energy. Never defeat relief devices, exceed ratings, open pressurised fittings or direct compressed air at skin/clothing. Air-injection injury can be serious.

For course identification use an isolated model and approved instructor procedure. Receiver draining, pressure adjustment, leak testing and live servicing require authorised instructions and actual system safeguards; no real measurement is claimed.
body.gu:
Pressure vessel/hoses માં dangerous stored energy છે. Relief bypass, rating exceed, pressurised fitting ખોલવું અથવા skin/clothes પર jet નહીં. Air injection serious injury કરી શકે.

Course માટે isolated model અને instructor procedure. Draining/adjustment/leak test/live servicing authorised instructions પ્રમાણે; actual measurement નો દાવો નથી.

a.en: Raise air pressure using mechanical work.
a.gu: Mechanical work થી air p વધારવું.

a.en: One compression stage between inlet and delivery.
Avoid contact/accommodate design; residual gas remains.
Pressure difference allows it to open.

a.gu: Cylinder p delivery requirement કરતાં વધે.

terms.en: Not inferred solely from cylinder number.
terms.gu: Cylinder count થી એકલું ન નક્કી થાય.

q.en: Practice: Explain its complete working cycle.
Practice: State selection factors and air-quality limits.
Practice: Explain normal control versus pressure relief.
